{{Recipe summary
| Category = Pizza recipes
| Yield = 1 medium-sized pizza
| Servings = 4
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Pizza|Pizza]]

==Ingredients==

* 2 boneless, skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken breasts]]
* Pizza dough (e.g. [[Cookbook:Basic Pizza Crust|Basic Pizza Crust]] or a pre-packaged dough for convenience)
* 1 large jar of [[Cookbook:Alfredo Sauce|Alfredo sauce]]
* 1 large package of shredded [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] (e.g. [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar]], [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella]])
* 1 package of [[Cookbook:Pepperoni|pepperoni]]

==Preparation==

# Cut up the chicken breast, and [[Cookbook:Searing|sear]]/[[Cookbook:Baking|bake]]/[[Cookbook:Grilling|grill]] it until it is cooked through. 
# Prepare the pizza crust and spread it on a medium-sized [[Cookbook:Pizza Pan|pizza pan]]. 
# Spread some Alfredo sauce on the crust, and top with cooked chicken. Repeat to make a few layers, then sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
# Bake in [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 350°F (175°C) for about 20 minutes or until the crust is done.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* You can add whatever you like if you find this recipe a bit bland.
* Add more of any of the ingredients if you would like.
